versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Tech Explainer skill.
- Helps users understand tricky technical terms in chats by explaining each one in plain, everyday language and relatable analogies.
- Detects technical terms in AI, programming, or other technology-related texts and breaks them down for beginners.
- Uses a friendly, conversational tone, prioritizing natural explanations over lists or tables.
- Designed especially for users with zero technical background, ensuring everyone can follow along.
